title: Two Brain Pathways Initiate Distinct Forward Walking Programs in Drosophila.
source_locator: Results 'A neural activation screen identifies candidate walking initiation neurons'; Fig. 1A-F; Fig. S1; Videos S1-S2
quote: SS01540 activation elicited forward walking with a strong turning component whereas SS01587 activation induced straight forward walking
mapping_basis: Paper says SS01540 labels DNp09 (Namiki et al. 2018 naming; henceforth P9); synonyms.csv and driver_lines.csv list DNp09/SS01540 as ambiguous (DNp09 or DNp71 via hemibrain naming); DNp09 chosen because the paper uses the Namiki DN split-GAL4 nomenclature.
stimulation: Screen: continuous white light 0.5 mW/cm2 for 7 min; retest: 630 nm ~4.5 mW/cm2 pulsed 50 Hz (5 ms), 30 s ON (grooming assay) or 10 s ON (copulation assay)
type_coverage: a pair of ipsilateral DNs (one cell per hemisphere)
sensory_condition: dark (transient assays, IR illumination); powdered grooming flies or females in copulation
other_cell_types: a few additional neurons (Figures S2A, S2B)
mushroom body gamma lobe neurites (CsChrimson expression present only in SS01540)
penetrance: reliably initiated walking in powdered (grooming) flies and in copulating females
n_flies_note: n=16-24 flies/genotype (grooming, Fig. 1C); n=9-11 (copulation, Fig. 1D); n=12-16 per condition in screen (Fig. 1B)
notes: Walking initiation from non-walking (grooming or copulating) state; walking coded yes for all legs per convention. Screen of 156 DN lines (Fig. 1A-B) increased walking >5-fold (powdered) and >1.2-fold (clean). Figure images not available in room; result taken from text and legends. Name ambiguity DNp09 vs DNp71 noted in notes.md.

title: Two Brain Pathways Initiate Distinct Forward Walking Programs in Drosophila.
source_locator: Results 'P9 DNs initiate forward walking with an ipsilateral turning component'; Fig. 2C-E; Video S3
quote: all animals that expressed CsChrimson unilaterally in the right P9 initiated forward walking with rightward turns (Figure 2D)
mapping_basis: P9 is the paper's short name for DNp09 labelled by SS01540 (Namiki naming); DNp09 is listed as ambiguous (DNp09/DNp71); DNp09 chosen as the paper uses Namiki nomenclature.
stimulation: 630 nm ~4.5 mW/cm2 pulsed 50 Hz (5 ms), transient ON periods (grooming assay protocol)
type_coverage: single P9 neuron (left or right) or both, by mosaic expression
other_cell_types: a few additional neurons in SS01540 (Figures S2A, S2B); mosaic animals selected by CsChrimson expression in P9
coordination_notes: unilateral P9 activation: forward walking with ipsilateral turns; bilateral mosaic: turns in both directions
penetrance: all unilateral-right animals turned right; left P9 animals turned left
n_flies_note: 3 bilateral (9 trials), 10 right (30 trials), 9 left (27 trials)
notes: Walking initiated from non-walking grooming state, hence leg rhythm coded yes rather than not_assessed. Figure images not available; from text and Fig. 2 legend.

title: Two Brain Pathways Initiate Distinct Forward Walking Programs in Drosophila.
source_locator: Results 'P9 DNs initiate forward walking with an ipsilateral turning component'; Fig. S2C-E
quote: Activating P9S2 neurons induced a walking initiation phenotype with a strong turning component similar to SS01540 (Figure S2E)
mapping_basis: P9S2 is the paper's second P9 (DNp09) split-GAL4; driver_lines.csv lists P9S2 as AMBIGUOUS (DNp09;DNp71); DNp09 chosen as the paper uses Namiki nomenclature.
stimulation: 630 nm ~4.5 mW/cm2 pulsed 50 Hz (5 ms), transient ON periods (grooming assay protocol, as stated for transient activation unless otherwise stated)
notes: P9S2 = VT005105-p65ADZp; VT023490-ZpGal4DBD (this study). Paper says it targets P9 but does not share off-target cells with SS01540; whether it has its own off-target cells is not stated. Supplementary Figure S2 not available in room; result from main text only.

title: Two Brain Pathways Initiate Distinct Forward Walking Programs in Drosophila.
source_locator: Results 'P9 DNs initiate forward walking with an ipsilateral turning component'; Fig. S2A-D, S2F-G; STAR Methods 'Freezing Assay'
quote: Regardless, in all cases, optogenetic stimulation increased both forward and angular velocity, corroborating that P9 activation elicits walking with a turning component.
mapping_basis: P9 = DNp09 labelled by SS01540 (Namiki naming); listed as ambiguous (DNp09/DNp71); DNp09 chosen as the paper uses Namiki nomenclature.
stimulation: Freezing assay: ~2.5 mW/cm2, 10 repetitions of 2 s continuous light ON, 10 s OFF, flat acrylic arena
sensory_condition: flat hard arena similar to Zacarias et al. 2018
other_cell_types: a few additional neurons (Figures S2A, S2B)
mushroom body gamma lobe neurites (SS01540 genotype, Figure S2G)
penetrance: freezing observed in only one of four genotypes; all genotypes initiated walking
notes: Text: freezing was observed in only one genotype, although all genotypes strongly label P9 and initiate walking on neural activation. In that genotype a transient locomotion increase was followed by stopping/freezing; possibly due to high CsChrimson expression or off-target cells. The four genotypes (Fig. S2A-D) may include the P9S2 line; driver listed as SS01540 only. Supplementary figures not available in room.

title: Two Brain Pathways Initiate Distinct Forward Walking Programs in Drosophila.
source_locator: Results 'P9 neurons are essential for object directed walking during courtship'; Fig. 4E-H; STAR Methods 'Remote-controlled female courtship assay'; Video S4
quote: The “remote-controlled” female was intermittently triggered to perform sudden forward walking and turning via P9 activation throughout the assay
mapping_basis: P9 = DNp09 labelled by SS01540 (Namiki naming); listed as ambiguous (DNp09/DNp71); DNp09 chosen as the paper uses Namiki nomenclature.
stimulation: 630 nm, 10 s OFF / 20 s ON for 10 minutes
sensory_condition: virgin female paired with a courting male; diffuse room lighting
other_cell_types: a few additional neurons (Figures S2A, S2B)
mushroom body gamma lobe neurites (SS01540 only)
notes: Activation used as a tool to make females a moving courtship target; female velocity traces in Fig. 4G show sudden velocity increases at light ON. Figure images not available in room.
